caption: Plan screen shown straight after onboarding: Free at $0 with 50 streaming hours counted per destination (1 hour on 3 platforms uses 3 hours), next to Creator Plus at $19.99 a month.
Creator Plus add-ons, all ticked by default: Clips +$19, Advanced Cloud recording +$19 and Upload & Stream +$39 a month.

Checkout with the default add-ons still ticked: 'Due today $96.98' for Creator Plus, with a 7-day money-back guarantee and no VAT line. We stopped here; the payment section with a saved card is hidden.
Storage after uploading our 6-second test MP4: Uploads 1/3 and available storage 66%, so the free limit counts files, not bytes; the account name is hidden.
Menu on the uploaded file: Schedule stream, Download, Trim video, Transcript (Upgrade), Show details, Rename and Delete; the account name is hidden.
Create event form for the uploaded file: title, date with the Europe/Amsterdam time zone, Loop video behind an upgrade and a pre-ticked option to create an event post in advance.
